newsitem.title: CYPRUS: SOCCER-CYPRUS F.A. PROBE BETTING ALLEGATIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CYPRUS F.A. PROBE BETTING ALLEGATIONS.

text.p: The Cyprus F.A. has launched an investigation into newspaper allegations that players in the national team placed bets on losing to Bulgaria in a World Cup qualifier on December 14.

Cyprus F.A. chairman Marios Lefkaritis said on Saturday: "What concerns us is that the integrity of football is at stake and even though we are talking about rumours we are embarrassed and want to clear the whole situation up.
"We are trying to collect as much information as possible...from betting shops to see what kind of amounts were at stake in the match."
